paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Analyst, Project Finance role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. UGE stood out because the role sits on assets still in development and construction, where the choice between debt, tax equity, mezzanine and HoldCo financing really changes the outcome.

In an MBA project I built project- and portfolio-level models for a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio, testing capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios. Our recommended phased green loan plus ABS strategy reduced sponsor equity by $11.1M and improved levered IRR from 8.58% to 9.79%. At Lenovo I spent two years building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%.

My project finance work so far comes from coursework rather than live transactions, so I would bring careful modeling, clean sensitivities and organized diligence tracking, and learn the closing side from your team. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
